comparison.objective: Sort two cloths into toilet and kitchen buckets according to a color code.
comparison.physical_skill: Semantic classification and coarse pick-and-place; no precision insertion, impact, force regulation, or fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Cloths must rest with centers inside their assigned bucket walls; wrong red-cloth placement forces zero. Release-distance and stability thresholds are not quantified.
comparison.reason: Tests rule-based sorting, with no meaningful overlap in the candidate’s fracture-and-recovery ability.
